hook_text: A tadpole and a frog look nothing alike. But they are the same animal.
clip_script: A growth project in Mthatha. Bean seeds in yoghurt tubs: root down, shoot up, leaves, flowers, pods. Eight fluffy chicks: down, then feathers, then hens. A height chart behind the door: everybody a few centimetres taller. Growing means getting bigger. Developing means changing. And some animals change completely. Egg, tadpole, frog. Egg, caterpillar, pupa, butterfly. That is called metamorphosis.
visual_style: Whiteboard height chart with pencil lines rising, then a bean, a chick and a tadpole each changing through stages.
mood: Bright and encouraging, like a class project coming to life.
pacing: Three quick growth examples, then the surprise of metamorphosis.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and start your own growth diary.
